# Conversions between TIMESTAMP and the civil types in a time zone.

# Which instant a civil time repeated at a daylight saving change converts to; America/Los_Angeles
# falls back at 02:00 PDT to 01:00 PST on 2024-11-03.

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP(DATETIME '2024-11-03 01:30:00', 'America/Los_Angeles') AS STRING)
?>

# The error for an unknown time zone that is not a literal.

SELECT CAST(DATETIME(TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 12:00:00+00', z) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['Invalid/Zone']) z
?>

# A civil time outside the DATETIME range, under SAFE.

SELECT CAST(SAFE.DATETIME(TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00', '-08:00') AS STRING)
?>

# The time of day of a civil time whose date is outside the DATETIME range.

SELECT CAST(TIME(TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00', '-08:00') AS STRING)
?>
